Resume
#

About
#

Technical-minded creative with 4+ years of experience in game development and technical art. Passionate about solving problems at the intersection of art and engineering—whether optimizing scenes, developing custom tools, or enhancing visuals through shaders and VFX. Skilled in Unity, Unreal Engine, C++, and C#. Currently working as a Technical Artist at Agate.
